description: This file defines the `PhotoLibraryService` class which implements photo retrieval and processing from the device's photo library. It includes methods for fetching recent photos, resizing images, encoding JPEGs under a size budget, and managing authorization. The class is tailored for use in a specific project related to media handling in an iOS application.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class for fetching and processing photos from the device's photo library, with internal logic for resizing and encoding images within specific size constraints.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos with specified parameters, respecting size and quality constraints, and manages authorization status.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns the current photo library authorization status without prompting the user.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Converts a PHAsset into a payload by resizing and encoding it as JPEG within size constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage to JPEG, reducing quality or size to stay within a max base64 size budget.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
